svg.title: Anomalies set: eight hypothetical motions
svg.desc: Eight panels: a high g turn, a burst of acceleration and braking, a sharp turn, a 6,096 metre vertical drop in one second, seven numbered dashes, a vertical loop, a J hook, and a path that enters the sea, travels 1 km at 100 m depth and comes back out. A speed trace sits under each panel. A ninth cell holds notes.
svg.text: Hypothetical paths set in the generator. They are not evidence of reported events.
start and end of the part drawn
equal time steps: wide is fast
Each panel is a short part of a 300 s track, at its own scale. g is acceleration in units of 9.81 m/s².
Outside the part drawn, the target flies straight and level at constant speed, or hovers. ping-pong is the exception.
